name: Hida Great Limestone Cave
description: One of Japan's nine association-member touring caves, the Hida Great Limestone Cave offers a 800 m course with limestone formations and an underground observation tower at the top of Mt. Kano.
notes: Admission ¥1,200 (adult); a cable car from Takayama's north reaches the cave entrance.
